<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Habit; // Importing the Habit model

class HabitPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool
    {
        return true; // Allow viewing any habit by any user
    }

    public function view(User $user, Habit $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow viewing a habit if the user is the owner
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool
    {
        return true; // Allow creating a habit by any user
    }

    public function update(User $user, Habit $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow updating a habit if the user is the owner
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Habit $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow deleting a habit if the user is the owner
    }
}
```
